text_block_list.text:
The St. Lite Kinen, the trial race for the Kikuka Sho.
The day we've been waiting for since spring has finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oho, Cafe's weight here...
It's significantly up compared to spring...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: However, this... Hehehe, this is completely different from an apparition. If the sheer physical advantage is overwhelming...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's different from before...
Deep inside my body, it feels different...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
There's no strange wriggling... I actually feel
like my body belongs to me properly...

It seems we've managed to ride out
the most unpredictable phase, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: If only I could run with this exact same feeling...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If I can overcome this hurdle...
Do you think I can make it to the Kikuka Sho...?

I couldn't give an immediate answer.
There are still too many unknown variables
when it comes to Manhattan Cafe's condition.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, discussing the results before the experiment
is utter nonsense.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Let us see the results on the turf.
What color the litmus paper known as Cafe will be stained.

I want to believe things will be painted in bright colors.
Today of all days, I have to find a way to break free
from this invisible mire.
